caption: The drawing features two detailed graphite illustrations of a spoon, presented horizontally across the center of a lightly textured, off-white paper. The top spoon is shown from its upper (concave) side, with the bowl on the left and the handle tapering towards the right, where it widens slightly at the end and features markings "I + D." The lower spoon is displayed from its underside, revealing the convex bowl and a flattened, slightly flared handle end, which has a rounded tip and additional engraved markings near the bowl. At the bottom left corner, there is a small technical sketch showing the spoon's side and top profiles with dimensions labeled in inches. The drawing is monochromatic, rendered entirely in shades of gray. Handwritten text "SCALE: 1/1" and a signature appear in the lower right corner. The overall composition is organized and symmetrical, with all elements enclosed within a single rectangular border.
title: Silver Spoon
